summary_en: 3,400 shares (0.05% of outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-06-02 at closing price of ¥1,302/share; upper limit ¥4.43M; single-session order window.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Share Repurchase via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Nagaoka International Corporation (TSE Standard, 6239) announced on 2026-06-01 that its Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of 3,400 treasury shares (0.05% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) with an upper limit of ¥4,426,800. The repurchase will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours electronic trading) on 2026-06-02 using a single-session order at the closing price of ¥1,302 per share observed on 2026-06-01. Results will be disclosed immediately after market close on the execution date. The company stated the purpose as improving capital efficiency and enabling flexible capital allocation in response to future changes in the business environment. The acquisition is subject to market conditions and may be executed in part or not at all.
